title: Verify live ACP supplied-MCP tool lifecycle through the shipped command
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve the nine real ACP/MCP bridge regressions and verify session-scoped typed tool start/completion/failure updates, live cancellation ordering, actual MCP isError handling, and fresh call IDs. No full ACP or model-continuation claim.

reuse.searched: Published actual shipped-binary ACP/MCP fixture, its Rust stdio child, isolated Git/Board and cleared environment setup, typed ACP tool event contract agreed with root/protocol owners.
reuse.reason: Extend the existing real execution fixture and evidence checks without mock executors, extra dependencies, external providers, or production changes.

coordination: Parent acp_mcp_design owns production composition/integration; protocol owner validates official wire schema; this worker owns tests only. No external Board posts, paid calls, pushes or production promotion.

validation.isolated_harness_check: Passed cargo check against existing path dependencies; this is a minimal checker manifest, not a root-package or shipped-path test result.
validation.isolated_harness_clippy: Passed cargo clippy on the same checker manifest with -D warnings.
validation.standalone_rust_child: Pinned rustc compile and actual initialize/tools-list/tools-call isError smoke passed, with three real JSON-RPC replies and a called trace.
validation.format: Scoped pinned rustfmt --check and git diff --check passed.
validation.shipped_e2e: Pending parent integration of production typed events; ten actual CLI tests are prepared, nine existing cases retained and strengthened.
validation.windows: Not executed. No Windows qualification claimed.

limitations: Typed lifecycle checks cover supplied session MCP tools only, not every builtin tool.
Model continuation with role=tool messages and full ACP conformance remain separate work.
No runtime source additions, dependencies, paid provider calls or external posts in this test slice.
